width.description: The width of the generated image.
width.title: Width

height.description: The height of the generated image.
height.title: Height

image_size.description: auto preserves source geometry, downscaled by the provider if needed. Only unmasked regular edits accept named presets or custom sizes: dimensions >=256, multiples of 32, area <=4194304, ratio <=6:1. Named presets use standard fal dimensions.
image_size.title: Image Size

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Random seed. Omit to choose automatically.

mask_url.title: Mask URL
mask_url.description: Mask matching the source dimensions. Black edits, white preserves. Must contain both regions after rounding.

reference_image_urls.description: Up to four references plus the primary source, or three references plus the primary source and mask.
reference_image_urls.title: Reference Image URLs

edit_precision.description: regular uses Generate; high uses Precise Edit with unchanged-pixel restoration. Both always prepare structured edit instructions.
edit_precision.title: Edit Precision

quality.description: Quality tier for either edit precision. Defaults to medium.
quality.title: Quality

sync_mode.description: Return image data directly in the response.
sync_mode.title: Sync Mode

content_type.title: Content Type

file_name.title: File Name
